purpose: Float32 on-fly waveform error against float64 at identical inputs, at the corners of the validated range and in stress cases, with each float32 reformulation disabled in turn.

method.inputs: float64 inputs are the exact float64 values of the float32 inputs, with f0*T = q_ref + offset; the float64 carrier q is pinned to the float32 carrier, q_ref unless a stress case moves it; caches are float32-rounded orbit_cache output
method.metrics: A and E stacked, computed in float64; mismatch uses a flat weighting over the band. tdi_response rows use X/Y/Z at 257 times spanning [t0, t0 + T].

stress.derivatives: fdot = ucb_fdot(chirp_mass, f0) at time zero and fddot = 11/3*fdot**2/f0; zero for a chirp mass of zero
stress.carrier: default: q_ref; middle: the bin of the frequency at t0 + T/2; an integer: that many bins from q_ref
stress.bandwidth: ucb_bw at the frequency and fdot mid-observation, widened to a power of two reaching back to a distant carrier

method.bandwidth: ucb_bw with N = T/5.0 s, amplitude as above
method.response_samples: the automatic count for T, passed explicitly
method.physical: tdi_waveform, all reformulations, Sangria, no cache; only where the carrier is the default
method.split: chirps only: split_native (at the case's carrier) and split_physical (default carrier only) of the unrounded float64 source, against float64 at the unrounded inputs; Sangria, no cache. Not part of the budget: it measures input rounding
